study.title: Eggplant Leaf Semantic Segmentation in Aerial Imagery for Precision Agriculture
study.short_title: Eggplant Leaf Segmentation in Aerial Imagery (FPN/VGG16)
study.venue: International Conference on Humanoid, Nanotechnology, Information Technology,Communication and Control, Environment and Management

segmentation.best_model: FPN + VGG16 (best accuracy & latency: PA 0.9724 @0.5; U-Net+VGG19 tops Dice/IoU/F1)

dataset.name: LeavesUAV (authors' eggplant farm, Philippines)
dataset.note: New LeavesUAV dataset from 1080p UAV/RGB flight-recordings of mature eggplant leaves; 1080p frames patched to 448x448x3 via sliding window; augmentation (saturation/hue/brightness/flip); train 60,750 (20% validation), test 1,350; binary leaf vs background; grayscale rendering with ImageNet normalization.

mIoU.ambiguity: Binary task evaluated with class-level IoU reported in Fig. 6 (values not fully extractable); U-Net+VGG19 highest at 0.5 threshold.

F1.quote: U-Net with VGG19 has a consistently exceptional performance, attaining the highest F1 score of 0.8080 at the 0.5 threshold
F1.ambiguity: Best F1 (leaf class, binary) = U-Net+VGG19 @0.5 threshold. The paper's recommended model, FPN+VGG16, has lower F1 but best pixel accuracy and latency (values in Fig. 6, not all quantities extractable).

Dice.ambiguity: Dice coefficients plotted in Fig. 6 (not text-extractable); U-Net+VGG19 highest @0.5.

PA.ambiguity: Best pixel accuracy (leaf vs background) across all models: FPN+VGG16 = 0.9724 @0.5 threshold and 0.9673 @0.75. Others: U-Net+VGG19 0.9696/0.9687, FPN+VGG19 0.9691/0.9633, U-Net+VGG16 0.9676/0.9622.

weed_F1.ambiguity: No weed class; binary leaf/background segmentation for vegetation-index-based sprayer.

crop_F1.ambiguity: Eggplant-leaf class F1 = 0.8080 (U-Net+VGG19 @0.5) captured under F1.

fps.ambiguity: Latency reported in ms; no FPS.

latency_ms.quote: FPN with VGG16 emerged as the most efficient, exhibiting the lowest average latency times for both thresholds, with 31.5 ms at 0.5 and 32.6 ms at 0.75
latency_ms.ambiguity: Average inference latency per 448x448 patch on DESKTOP hardware (NVIDIA RTX 3060 6 GB, models evaluated on 1,350 test images); U-Net+VGG19 slowest at 38.5/39.6 ms. Not measured on embedded/payload hardware even though intended for a UAV variable sprayer system.

issues: Conference paper; all quantitative results in figures (Fig. 6); many exact metric values (IoU/Dice/F1 for other configs) not extractable from text.
Latency measured on desktop RTX 3060, not UAV payload hardware.
Best-model ambiguity: recommended FPN+VGG16 by accuracy/latency; U-Net+VGG19 highest Dice/IoU/F1.
